mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 56 degrees near Harriet Park, under the illumination of a new moon.

In city news, the Verona Police Department is inviting residents to apply for their Citizen Academy, a nine week course covering topics like O W I investigations and fire arms education. Additionally, the city has posted official notices regarding the upcoming November general election.

There is plenty to do in town with live music happening today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmer's Market or enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, Verona will host the exciting Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival this Saturday.
Regarding the weekly report, police investigated a case on Sunday August 30 involving a school staff member, which remains an active and open investigation.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Raspberry Cheesecake. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and grab a scoop.
